collection.title: BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe 2014 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe 2014 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: BMW 4 Series Gran Coupe 2014 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
